from common import *
import numpy as np
import random

# concepts: respiratory action, flame-extinguishing, temporal progression, static background
# description: Input shows a black background with a green checkered floor, several vertical striped shapes each topped by a small flame, a round red object with a yellow border, and a person sprite. The output is identical to the input except all the flame pixels are extinguished (removed).

def main(input_grid):
    output_grid = input_grid.copy()
    output_grid[output_grid == Color.ORANGE] = Color.BLACK
    return output_grid

def generate_input():
    h,w = np.random.randint(12,30), np.random.randint(12,30)
    grid = np.full((h,w), Color.BLACK)
    # static green checkered floor
    floor_height = np.random.randint(3, h//3+3)
    floor_start = h - floor_height
    for i in range(floor_start, h):
        for j in range(w): grid[i,j] = Color.GREEN if (i+j)%2 else Color.TEAL
    # vertical striped shapes
    stripe_positions = []
    for _ in range(np.random.randint(3,6)):
        sw = np.random.randint(1,4); sh = np.random.randint(3, floor_start-1)
        c1,c2 = random.sample([c for c in Color.NOT_BLACK if c not in [Color.GREEN,Color.TEAL]], 2)
        stripe = np.zeros((sh, sw), int)
        for x in range(sw): stripe[:,x] = c1 if x%2==0 else c2
        sx,sy = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, stripe, background=Color.BLACK)
        blit_sprite(grid, stripe, sx, sy)
        stripe_positions.append((sx,sy,sh,sw))
    # small flames on top of each stripe
    fs = np.random.randint(2,4)
    flame = np.full((fs,fs), Color.ORANGE)
    for sx,sy,sh,sw in stripe_positions:
        fx = sx - fs; fy = sy + (sw - fs)//2
        blit_sprite(grid, flame, fx, fy)
    # round red object with yellow border
    rr = np.full((3,3), Color.RED)
    for a,b in [(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,2),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2)]: rr[a,b] = Color.YELLOW
    x,y = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, rr, background=Color.BLACK)
    blit_sprite(grid, rr, x, y)
    # simple person sprite
    p = np.array([[Color.PINK, Color.PINK],[Color.MAROON, Color.MAROON]])
    x,y = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, p, background=Color.BLACK)
    blit_sprite(grid, p, x, y)
    return grid

from common import *
import numpy as np
import random

# input grid: black background, lower green/teal checker region, vertical stripe components, orange marker cells, one bordered 3x3 component, and one separate 2x2 component
# output: copy of input grid with every orange marker cell changed to black

def main(input_grid):
    result_grid = input_grid.copy()
    result_grid[result_grid == Color.ORANGE] = Color.BLACK
    return result_grid


def generate_input():
    height, width = np.random.randint(12,30), np.random.randint(12,30)
    grid = np.full((height,width), Color.BLACK)
    # lower checker region
    region_height = np.random.randint(3, height//3+3)
    region_start = height - region_height
    for row in range(region_start, height):
        for col in range(width):
            grid[row,col] = Color.GREEN if (row+col)%2 else Color.TEAL
    # vertical stripe components
    stripe_positions = []
    for _ in range(np.random.randint(3,6)):
        stripe_width = np.random.randint(1,4)
        stripe_height = np.random.randint(3, region_start-1)
        color_a, color_b = random.sample([c for c in Color.NOT_BLACK if c not in [Color.GREEN, Color.TEAL]], 2)
        stripe = np.zeros((stripe_height, stripe_width), int)
        for x in range(stripe_width):
            stripe[:,x] = color_a if x%2==0 else color_b
        x0, y0 = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, stripe, background=Color.BLACK)
        blit_sprite(grid, stripe, x0, y0)
        stripe_positions.append((x0, y0, stripe_height, stripe_width))
    # orange marker blocks above each stripe component
    marker_size = np.random.randint(2,4)
    marker = np.full((marker_size,marker_size), Color.ORANGE)
    for x0, y0, stripe_height, stripe_width in stripe_positions:
        marker_x = x0 - marker_size
        marker_y = y0 + (stripe_width - marker_size)//2
        blit_sprite(grid, marker, marker_x, marker_y)
    # bordered 3x3 component
    bordered_cell = np.full((3,3), Color.RED)
    for row, col in [(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,2),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2)]:
        bordered_cell[row,col] = Color.YELLOW
    x0, y0 = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, bordered_cell, background=Color.BLACK)
    blit_sprite(grid, bordered_cell, x0, y0)
    # separate 2x2 component
    component = np.array([[Color.PINK, Color.PINK],[Color.MAROON, Color.MAROON]])
    x0, y0 = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, component, background=Color.BLACK)
    blit_sprite(grid, component, x0, y0)
    return grid
